back: $fg(x) = f\big(g(x)\big)$: apply $g$ first, then $f$. Usually $fg \neq gf$.

front: Domain and range of an inverse
back: Domain of $f^{-1}$ = range of $f$; range of $f^{-1}$ = domain of $f$.
Write $y = f(x)$, make $x$ the subject, swap $x$ and $y$, then state the domain of $f^{-1}$.
The reflection of $y = f(x)$ in the line $y = x$; $(a, b)$ maps to $(b, a)$.

front: Which square root for the inverse of a restricted quadratic?
back: Choose the sign that matches the domain of $f$: for $x \geq h$, $x = h + \sqrt{\ldots}$.
$(fg)^{-1} = g^{-1}f^{-1}$: undo the last function first.
